lab_questions.title: Cold Chain Telemetry & Route Milestone Tracking
lab_questions.description: Sensitive pharmaceutical shipments require strictly verified route progression and temperature logging. The tracking API currently accepts waypoint updates out of sequence and ignores temperature excursions reported by IoT vehicle sensors.
lab_questions.startup_command: python manage.py migrate && python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:8010

tasks.title: Strict Sequential Waypoint Enforcement
tasks.description:
The `POST /api/shipments/{id}/checkpoints/` endpoint allows drivers to mark milestone checkpoints in arbitrary order (e.g., logging "Out for Delivery" before "Customs Clearance").

**Goal:** Validate milestone submissions against the predefined `RouteStop.order_index`. Reject any checkpoint submission if any earlier mandatory waypoint has not been marked as `COMPLETED`. Allow non-waypoint telemetry pings (GPS updates) without triggering milestone validation errors.

tasks.title: Temperature Anomaly Detection & Auto-Quarantine
tasks.description:
IoT sensors stream temperature logs to `POST /api/shipments/{id}/telemetry/`. The system records the data points but fails to flag shipments that exceed thermal safety limits (-20°C to -10°C).

**Goal:** Ingest telemetry logs. If 3 consecutive readings breach the shipment's configured temperature threshold (`min_temp` / `max_temp`), automatically transition the `Shipment.status` to `QUARANTINED`, set `is_compromised = True`, and generate an `IncidentLog`. Isolated transient readings (1 or 2 outlier sensor glitches followed by normal temperatures) must not trigger quarantine.

tasks.title: Cryptographic Proof-of-Delivery (POD) Verification
tasks.description:
The `POST /api/shipments/{id}/complete/` endpoint marks packages as delivered without validating recipient authorization, allowing unauthorized completion.

**Goal:** Require a 6-digit delivery passcode or HMAC token in the completion request. Hash the incoming passcode using Python's `hashlib.sha256` and compare against the recipient's stored `delivery_passcode_hash`. Transition shipment to `DELIVERED` and record `delivered_at` only upon a valid match.
